onboarding.welcome.title: WARRIORLOG
onboarding.welcome.body: Your body is the character sheet. Twelve weeks, six days a week, two warriors, one belt.
onboarding.equipment.title: Muster the armoury
onboarding.equipment.body: Tell us what you actually own. Every target is written against your own kit.
onboarding.health.title: The health screen
onboarding.health.body: Answer honestly. A yes locks the run and swing tests until a doctor clears it — that is a lock, not a judgement.
onboarding.quiz.title: Placement
onboarding.quiz.body: Eight questions. They set your first rung on every ladder so week one fits you exactly.
onboarding.rest.title: Choose your rest day
onboarding.time.title: Your usual hour and your anchor
onboarding.done.title: Faced the Mirror
onboarding.done.body: Iron outline, empty silhouette, level 2. Everything from here you earn.
home.quest.skirmish_hint: A Skirmish is three exercises, three rounds, fifteen minutes. It keeps the Flame and it counts as a session.
home.quest.rest_day: Rest link today. The Flame holds on its own.
home.quest.kindle: Optional Kindle walk — 20 min or more pays 20 XP and Zone-2 minutes.
home.done.body: Tomorrow's quest shows up here after 4 a.m.
body.armour.intro: Earned by passing a boss test or reaching a named rung. Never bought with XP.
body.armour.top: Gold, the top tier. Nothing more to earn here.
home.numbers.title: Numbers to beat
home.numbers.ladder: {exercise} climbs to {step_name} with one more qualifying session
quest.warmup.title: Warm-up flow
quest.warmup.body: Walk, hinge rehearsal, pattern rehearsal. One tap when you are through. No XP, all upside.
quest.checklist.title: Five cues — tap any cue that slipped
quest.rir.title: Reps left in the tank
quest.pain.logged: Pain flagged {value}/10. This stays on your phone and steers next week.
quest.cardio.talk_ok: Talk test: I could hold a sentence
quest.cardio.talk_hard: Talk test: too breathless to hold a sentence
quest.cardio.talk_hard_note: Those minutes still pay 2 XP each and still count as work.
complete.title: QUEST COMPLETE
complete.subtitle: {template} · {minutes} min · {hit} of {total} targets
complete.duo_flame_one: {name} still to train — one flame lit
complete.duo_flame_both: Duo Flame {duo_flame} — both of you today
complete.pledge.title: Tomorrow's pledge
ladders.title: Ladders
ladders.rule: Advance: {rule} on two full quests in a row
ladders.skirmish_note: Skirmishes keep the Flame; only full quests advance a ladder.
ladders.deload_note: Deload week — ladders rest and hold their rung.
ladders.regression: Stepped back to {step_name}: {reason}. Step held — you keep every rung you earned.
body.title: Body
body.iron_moved: Iron moved: {total} lb — stays on this phone
armory.title: Armory
flame.rest_held: Rest link {day} — Step held, you keep every rung
flame.recovery: Recovery mode · day {n} of {total}. The Flame is frozen, not spent.
flame.away: Away mode · day {n} of {total}. The Flame is frozen.
flame.rekindled: Rekindled at {flame}. Nothing was taken from you.
flame.milestone_66: Automatic — sixty-six days, the habit is yours
flame.perfect_week: PERFECT WEEK — +{xp} XP and a shield
duo.flame_pending: Today is pending until tomorrow night — log late, it still counts.
duo.flame_ember: Duo Ember — three shared days restores {duo_flame}
duel.title: The Belt
duel.fairness: Every bar is what you did against what YOUR program asked of you. Load, reps and speed never enter the score.
duel.other_win: {name} takes the Belt this week. Your strongest category: {category}.
duel.dead_heat: Dead heat — half a crown each
duel.no_contest: No contest this week. It sits outside the record entirely.
duel.exhibition: Exhibition week — the Belt goes on the line from next Monday.
duel.alliance: Alliance Week — 150 combined wins it for both. You are at {total}.
boss.title: Boss Arena
boss.training_camp: TRAINING CAMP — prefills are frozen until the battle
boss.deload: Deload week. Lighter sets on purpose; the ladders hold.
boss.no_defeat: A boss can never take anything from you. Every test you log pays, whatever the number says.
boss.split: Split the battle — move tests 5 and 6 to your next training day
boss.rematch: Rematch offered for {tests} within 7 days. Best of two counts.
boss.locked_health: Locked until the health screen is cleared.
boss.result.title: {boss} · {outcome}
boss.result.wounded: WOUNDED — one week of rematches is open
boss.result.escaped: ESCAPED — it returns next boss week carrying +10 revenge damage for you
boss.coop.explain: Combined damage counts the smaller number twice. The lighter hitter decides the fight.
boss.coop.solo: Solo battle — half HP, and it counts for you alone.
boss.loot: Loot: +{pct}% of this week's available XP to each of you
journal.title: Journal
journal.report.title: Weekly Report · Week {week}
journal.empty: Nothing logged yet this week. The first set writes the first line.
badges.title: Badges
settings.title: Settings
settings.recovery.body: Sick or hurt. Up to 7 days, extendable once. Unlimited uses, no cost, no questions.
settings.away.body: Travel or life. Up to 7 days, twice a season. The Flame freezes.
settings.share_numbers.body: Off by default. {name} sees hit or not-hit and rung names either way.
settings.private: Never synced: body weight, measurements, photos, reps in reserve, pain flags, notes, heart rate, vest weight, placement answers.
settings.move_write_slot: Move the write slot to this phone
sync.offline: Offline. Everything is saved here and goes up on the next connection.
sync.conflict: Two versions of week {week}. Keeping the later one; your sets are all intact.
sync.contract: This phone writes only your own files and reads {name}'s.
nudge.duo_flame_risk: Duo Flame {duo_flame} — a session tonight keeps it. {template} is about {minutes} min.
nudge.ember_live: Rekindle window: {n} more shared days restores your flame to {flame}.
nudge.boss_window: {name} has {theirs} of 6 benchmarks logged, you have {mine} of 6 · {days} days in the window.
nudge.belt_reach: {name} leads {theirs}–{mine}. One {action} would put you ahead.
nudge.partner_done: {name} is done for today ({template}, {minutes} min). Yours: {my_template}, about {my_minutes} min.
nudge.belt_defence: {name} is {n} points up — the Belt is on the line tomorrow.
nudge.alliance: Alliance Week: 150 combined wins it for both — you are at {total}.
